bestBets.overview: 14 and 16 unlikely to be here. Plenty of speed, as you'd expect. INAZUMA BOY had a progressive prep last time around, winning three in the campaign. One recent trial at Muswellbrook and it was OK, in some reasonable company. CASTLEBAR ROAD comes to it after winning on both wet and dry and will land on the speed without too much early work. GITALONG has been winning off the beaten track. Hard to know how that form will translate but he is obviously in good shape.
